label: v1.0.1-260920
changelog: [feature] Hold space, backspace, or delete to repeat: every 500ms for 1.5s, then every 250ms
[feature] Hold L, M, or R under the trackpad to keep that mouse button down until you lift; tap still clicks
[feature] Cut, Copy, and Paste keys (Ctrl+X, C, V) when the Tab row is wide enough, or as their own row when leftover height allows it
[feature] Live theme: a flying home bubble opens a panel to try looks, key style, and borders on the keyboard
[feature] Mouse-only home: a trackpad-only layout, switched from the trackpad button on the pad
[feature] Extended keyboard: numbers, symbols, and punctuation sit above the letter keys
[feature] Landscape trackpad grows over nearby letter keys while you move or scroll, then shrinks after 3 seconds or a tap
[improvement] Landscape trackpad-only mode keeps a 10px margin around the pad
[improvement] App icon is the family glass tile with the pearl laptop-trackpad mark
[improvement] Trackpad layout button uses an outline laptop-trackpad mark
[improvement] Grown pad top corners match the keys so they cover the letter corners during the grow
[improvement] Closing the live theme panel with X also turns off the flying preview bubble
[improvement] Trackpad and L / M / R use the same border as the keys
[improvement] Landscape pad dim covers the whole screen, including the status bar and home indicator
[improvement] Landscape pad grows down one key row, with a stronger dim you can tap to shrink
[improvement] Trackpad chrome sits 3px below the pad edge; the trackpad and settings buttons sit in the bottom corners
[improvement] Larger trackpad surface on the keyboard home (buttons sit below it, not inside the pad height)
[improvement] Key size is Normal or Larger (25% taller); Compact, Mini, and Mini round are gone
[improvement] Space bar branding matches AmL Secure Keyboard: still bird with wings sits next to the label on the bottom of the key
[improvement] Extra 8px under the last key row, above the home indicator, so the corner keys clear the screen curve
[improvement] Space bar branding sits 4px lower on the key
[improvement] Letter rows no longer show unused digit hints
[improvement] Extended numbers and punctuation use a slightly different key shade
[improvement] Ctrl, Alt, and Win show a green dot while latched
[improvement] Shift tap capitalizes the next letter; double-tap Shift for Caps Lock
[improvement] Tab and Esc sit before Ctrl, and stay title case when Shift is on
[improvement] xD types xD after a 500ms hold
[improvement] Mouse buttons sit under the pad at a normal key height
[improvement] Landscape letter keys fill their halves and grow into leftover height when extended is on
[improvement] Phone landscape keeps Connect or disconnect on the pad, with trackpad and settings in the corners
[improvement] Home shows Connect or disconnect, not both; Helper pairing is in Settings
[improvement] Extended numbers hide in landscape when they would not fit, then come back in portrait
[improvement] Trackpad glow follows a finger off the pad after the gesture starts there
[improvement] QWERTY asdfghjkl sits centered under the top letter row
[improvement] Graphite with a thin dark-gray key border is the default look
[improvement] Key borders include Dark gray, between Gray and Black
[improvement] Extended keyboard drops the ?123 key because those keys are already on screen
[improvement] Shift grows into leftover space on the letter row; the letter keys stay one-key wide and are not inset from the sides
[improvement] Back swipe on the keyboard stays in the app; from Settings it returns home
[improvement] Bluetooth advertises as AOW Keyboard
[improvement] Symbols match the MessageMe in-app keyboard, including =\ for a second page of missing keys
[improvement] Del on the extended punctuation row is two keys wide
[improvement] Tab, Esc, Ctrl row has the same gap below it as every other key row
[improvement] Pairing no longer asks you to close OneDrop
[bugfix] Trackpad touch rings no longer freeze on screen after the pad grows
[bugfix] Landscape no longer duplicates the space / ?123 row on the left
[bugfix] Symbol punctuation keys stay the same width as the number row
[bugfix] Symbols page no longer shows two ABC keys
[bugfix] Backspace stays on the right at two-key width; leftover keys on that row sit against it
[bugfix] Live theme bubble can be tapped and actually changes the keyboard look
[bugfix] Helper BLE advertising no longer fails as DATA_TOO_LARGE, so the computer helper can see the phone
[bugfix] Helper BLE puts AOW Keyboard in the packet Windows reads first, so it is not Unknown until you tap it
[bugfix] HID also broadcasts AOW Keyboard in the BLE packet Windows reads, so Add a device is not only Unknown
[bugfix] AZERTY letters send the HID keys Windows AZERTY expects, so A types A instead of Q
[bugfix] Trackpad pointer is faster at the same sensitivity, and long swipes are no longer clipped to 127 HID units
[bugfix] Tap then hold keeps the mouse button down so you can drag
[bugfix] Tap then hold is a drag, not a double-click, because the first tap waits until you lift or keep holding
[bugfix] Landscape letter keys, ;!?, Enter, ABC, and ?123 keep a fixed width; leftover goes to space instead of stretching those keys
[bugfix] After an update, HID reconnects to the Windows PC that is already paired instead of asking to pair again
